bugs.title: [BUG] App API - /api/* data plane - All endpoints return HTTP 500 while SPA shells 200
bugs.description:
Every first-party `app.gas.cash/api/*` call in the logged-in network audit returned HTTP 500 with a uniform `code:internal` envelope. SPA document shells still load 200. Privy auth is healthy. Soft-fail UI copy matches these 500s 1:1 across Mini Mart, Live pumps, Leaderboard, ATM, and Inventory.

**Retest 2026-10-26 (Fixed):** /api/* recovered — 0×5xx in session (980×2xx / 33×4xx). Soft-fail banners gone on map/shop/pumps.

Uniform body: {"ok":false,"kind":"error","code":"internal","message":"Something went wrong. Try again.","requestId":"hkg1::…"}

Geolocation granted (synthetic HCMC coords)
No txs signed; money-safe journey only
steps: Open https://app.gas.cash while authenticated.
Navigate across shells: `/`, `/garage`, `/mini-mart`, `/atm` (+ My Stakes), `/leaderboard`, `/mileage`, `/dealership`, `/proof`, `/chopshop`, `/pitstop`.

bugs.actual: All `https://app.gas.cash/api/*` calls return HTTP 500 with shared `code:internal` + `hkg1::` requestIds. UI shows soft-fails (shop, pumps, leaderboard, Robinhood Chain, inventory, blank balances). SPA shells still 200. Privy 2xx.
bugs.expected: Authed `/api/*` business endpoints return 2xx with data; soft-fail banners absent when the session is valid. SPA and data plane should both be healthy for a logged-in user.

bugs.description:

**Retest 2026-10-26 (Still valid):** Chrome still refetches on each nav — me/stats×7, scratch/tiers×7, claims/live×14, lineup×5 across 7 routes.
testData: Observed counts (single logged-in journey): GET /api/me/stats ×38, GET /api/games/scratch/tiers ×38, GET /api/lineup ×34, GET /api/claims/live ×27
Burst: me/stats & scratch tiers up to 3/3s; lineup up to 5/3s

DevTools Network open; filter XHR/fetch to app.gas.cash/api

Client-navigate through garage, mini-mart, atm, leaderboard, mileage, dealership.
Compare request counts for `/api/me/stats`, `/api/games/scratch/tiers`, `/api/claims/live`, `/api/lineup` across phases.

bugs.title: [BUG] Map - Location permission - Allow this time prompt reappears after later actions
bugs.description:
On Chrome, after the user answers the location permission bubble with **Allow this time** (one-shot grant, not "Allow while visiting the site"), the same "Know your location" / Allow this time prompt reappears after later UI actions (nav map/garage/minimart, reopen claim/map, refresh, etc.). Product repeatedly re-requests geolocation in a way that surfaces Chrome's one-time permission UI again, interrupting the session.

Primary evidence is a user screenshot of the Chrome bubble on app.gas.cash. Lab headed Playwright+AX attempt could not reliably observe the native bubble (Chrome often suppresses/hides it under automation profiles); subsequent lab location suites use Playwright `permissions: ['geolocation']` + `setGeolocation` and are tracked separately (`gc-location-browser-geo-ignored`).
testData: Permission choice: Allow this time (NOT Allow while visiting the site / Always allow)
Evidence: /evidence/adhoc-ui-api-20261027/470-loc-allow-this-time-user.png (user capture of Know your location / Allow this time bubble)
Lab note: repro-allow-this-time.mjs — AX observed permission UI as hidden; reappearedAfterAllow=false under automation; user capture remains authoritative for the Chrome one-time UX
precondition: Logged-in session on https://app.gas.cash
Chrome has not permanently allowed location for the site (no while-visiting / Always grant stored)
App shows Know your location / location CTA that triggers navigator geolocation
Money-safe; do not complete paid claims
steps: Open https://app.gas.cash while authenticated.
When Chrome shows Know your location for app.gas.cash, choose Allow this time (not Allow while visiting the site).
Perform subsequent UI actions: navigate Map / Garage / Mini Mart, reopen claim/map surfaces, and/or refresh.
Observe whether the same Chrome location permission bubble returns.
bugs.actual: After Allow this time, later map/claim/nav/refresh actions cause the same Chrome location permission popup (Know your location / Allow this time / Allow while visiting the site / Never allow) to reappear repeatedly.
bugs.expected: One Allow this time grant should cover the immediate location need without repeatedly interrupting the user with the same Chrome permission bubble on every later map/claim/nav action in the same short session. If the product must re-query geo, it should prefer a durable site grant path (prompt for while-visiting) or reuse the one-shot result without re-prompt storms; permanent deny/block soft-fail remains correct.

apiNotes: Chrome one-time (Allow this time) permission does not persist across subsequent getCurrentPosition calls the way while-visiting does — product re-prompt UX should account for this.
Automated lab follows up with Playwright permissions:['geolocation'] + setGeolocation (see GC-TC-V-LOC-01..03 / gc-location-browser-geo-ignored), not native Allow this time clicking.
